# The Kunnumpurathu Kudumbam

*Puthencavu · Chengannur · Kerala · India*

Kunnumpurathu is one of the oldest Orthodox Syrian Christian families of **Puthencavu**, a village on the bank of the river Pampa, about two kilometres east of Chengannur in the Alappuzha district of Kerala. The forefathers of the family **migrated from Kuravilangad**. Many of its members are today spread all over the world. At Puthencavu there are now nine families of the kudumbam.

## The branches

The main branches and sub-branches of the kudumbam are:

- **Maachaanangu** (Theruvil, Manglavil, Thelliyoor & Othara)
- **Veettil** (Malayil Georchayan & Babychayan)
- **Kochuveettil** (Kizhakke Kochuveetil, Padinjare, Kollam, Malayil & Goa)
- **Kochappantangu** (Theruvil, Kollam & Malayil)
- **Angeveettil** (Theruvil, Kayamkulam, Thiruvananthapuram & Kottayam)
- **Sasthampurathu** (Chengannur)

The family record gathered here covers the Machanangu (Joshua), Veettil, Kochuveettil and Kochappantangu lineages in detail. The Angeveettil and Sasthampurathu branches, and several sub-branches (Kochuveettil Padinjare, Kochuveettil Malayil, and the Kunjuchayan family of Goa), are noted on the original site but not yet fully recorded.

## Puthencavu at a glance

- **Metropolitan High School, Puthencavu** — one of the oldest schools in the region, established by Mar Philaxinos in 1948. Most of the younger generation of the Kunnumpurathu family were educated here; Shri K. K. Abraham of Kunnumpurathu taught here for many years.
- **St. Mary's Cathedral** — one of the oldest churches of the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church, now declared a cathedral and a place of pilgrimage, holding the mortal remains of three great Metropolitans. The church perunals of Mar Anthrayos and of Puthencavu Mar Philaxinos are celebrated here.
- **Pallippadi**, the river **Pampa**, and the old Thookkupalam crossing to Edanad are part of the village's living memory.

## The Kudumbayogam

The Kunnumpurathu Kudumbayogam holds an Annual General Meeting — its 13th was held at St. Andrews Hall, Puthencavu on 23 May 2009.

## Source

This record was first gathered and maintained by **Dr. K. K. Kochukoshy (Monoy)** of Puthencavu, at *kunnumpurathu.com* (last updated 5 May 2009). It has been transcribed here to be corrected, expanded and continued by the family.

*"How good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!" (Psalm 133)*

p_keevarchan.name: Gheevarghese (Keevarchan)
p_keevarchan.bio: Progenitor of the Machanangu branch of the Kunnumpurathu family. Had one son (Joshua) and three daughters (Anna, Aachchi, Sosamma). None of his children or children-in-law are living today.
p_keevarchan.notes: Earliest recorded ancestor of this lineage.

p_joshua.name: Joshua (K. G. Koshy)
p_joshua.bio: Eldest child and only son of Keevarchan. Of Puthencavu, Chengannur. Traditionally involved in the business of trading cashew, pepper and other commodities. Married Eliyamma of Vazhakkunnathu, Cherukole, Kozhencherry; they had seven children.

p_eliyamma.name: Eliyamma
p_eliyamma.bio: Of Vazhakkunnathu, Cherukole, Kozhencherry. Wife of Joshua (K. G. Koshy).

p_anna.name: Anna
p_anna.bio: Daughter of Keevarchan. Married into the Panil Vadakkethil family of Ulakad, Pandalam.

p_johnny.name: Johnny
p_johnny.bio: Son of Anna. Retired as a school teacher. Has two sons and one daughter.

p_aachchi.name: Aachchi
p_aachchi.bio: Daughter of Keevarchan. Married into the Mannilthundiyil family at Peralasseri. Had two daughters.

p_pennamma_m.name: Pennamma
p_pennamma_m.bio: Daughter of Aachchi; married and well off.

p_thankamma_m.name: Thankamma
p_thankamma_m.bio: Daughter of Aachchi; married and well off.

p_sosamma.name: Sosamma
p_sosamma.bio: Daughter of Keevarchan. Married Thomas of Plavilakandathil, Kallara. Had two sons and two daughters, settled in Arattupuzha.

p_kuriakose.name: Kuriakose
p_kuriakose.bio: Son of Sosamma. Retired as a branch manager of the State Bank of India.

p_sosamma_baby.name: Baby
p_sosamma_baby.bio: Son of Sosamma. Stays at Arattupuzha with his wife and only son.

p_chellamma.name: Chellamma
p_chellamma.bio: Daughter of Sosamma. A teacher, married and well settled.

p_elikkutty.name: Elikkutty
p_elikkutty.bio: Daughter of Sosamma. A teacher, married and well settled.

p_ammini.name: Ammini (Saramma Koshy)
p_ammini.bio: Eldest of Joshua's seven children. Married K. M. Varghese of Kammancheril, Thumpamon. Both retired from the Madhya Pradesh Electricity Board, Jabalpur, and settled at Thumpamon. She passed away on 15 August 2004.

p_kmvarghese.name: K. M. Varghese
p_kmvarghese.bio: Of Kammancheril, Thumpamon. Husband of Ammini. Retired from the Madhya Pradesh Electricity Board, Jabalpur.

p_shaji.name: Shaji (K. V. Mathews)
p_shaji.bio: Son of Ammini. Works with SBI, Pathanamthitta branch. Married Suma, daughter of V. C. Mathews of MRF Madras.

p_suma_v.name: Suma
p_suma_v.bio: Daughter of V. C. Mathews of MRF Madras. Wife of Shaji.

p_kkvarughese.bio: Second of Joshua's children. Former Accounts Officer, KSEB. Married Babykutty of Planthodathu, Adoor; settled at Vellakulangara, Manakkala, Adoor with three children. Passed away on 2 November 2004.

p_pjjacob.name: Kunjumon (P. J. Jacob)

p_kochukoshy.name: Dr. K. K. Kochukoshy (Monoy)
p_kochukoshy.occupation: Librarian, Central Reference Library, Kolkata; General Editor, Indian National Bibliography
p_kochukoshy.education: MA Sociology & BLib Sc (Jabalpur University); M.L.I.Sc (University of Madras); research, Calcutta University
p_kochukoshy.bio: Kunnumpurathu Koshy Kochukoshy (Monoy), youngest of Joshua's seven children. Born in Puthencavu on the bank of the river Pampa. Schooled at the Metropolitan High School, Puthencavu; graduated in Chemistry from Christian College, Chengannur. Took his MA in Sociology and BLib Sc from Jabalpur University, and M.L.I.Sc from the University of Madras. Began his career as Librarian-cum-teacher at St. Mary's Higher Secondary School, Madras (1975), then the University of Calicut, and in 1977 joined the Indian National Bibliography unit at the Central Reference Library, Kolkata, rising to head the Library and serve as General Editor of the Indian National Bibliography and Index Indiana. Nominated by Sam Pitroda to the Working Group on Libraries of the National Knowledge Commission. Was General Secretary of the Calcutta Kerala Samajam in the early 1980s; a life member of the ILA and IASLIC. Designed and maintained the original kunnumpurathu.com family record. Lives at Behala, Kolkata, with his wife Elizabeth (Kunjumol).
p_kochukoshy.notes: Author and keeper of the original kunnumpurathu.com family site.
